title: Family Ties
content: This isn’t a dream but concerns my family, it seems that a lot of relatives on my paternal line have the Vivid/Lucid ability. I suspect that it comes down from my paternal grandmother. My older cousin closed the circle for me in a post he sent me on FB messenger after he read the intro to my book. My sister and her youngest have terrible dreams, they offered the info before I could tell them about mine, and the book I was in the process of compiling. My question to many of you is: Have you found a family connection to Lucid and vivid dreams?
